With HRV trends you can learn your health level changes. A up hill trend means a better physical fitness level and a down hill indicates you should pay more attention to your overall health. 6. Send your ECG report to your healthcare provider

So what is HRV?
HRV is a measure of your autonomic nervous system that is widely considered one of the best objective metrics for physical fitness and determining your body’s readiness to perform.

Although HRV manifests as a function of your heart rate, it actually originates from your nervous system. Your autonomic nervous system, which controls the involuntary aspects of your physiology, has two branches, parasympathetic (deactivating) and sympathetic (activating).

The parasympathetic branch (often referred to as “rest and digest”) handles inputs from internal organs, like digestion or your fingernails and hair growing. It causes a decrease in heart rate. The sympathetic branch (often called “fight or flight”) reflects responses to things like stress and exercise, and increases your heart rate.

Heart rate variability comes from these two competing branches simultaneously sending signals to your heart. If your nervous system is balanced, your heart is constantly being told to beat slower by your parasympathetic system, and beat faster by your sympathetic system. This causes a fluctuation in your heart rate: HRV.

◆◇ What's Schulte Table?

A table in which numbers from 1 to 25 are arranged randomly in a 5x5 square.

It is one of the brain training techniques that appear in the best-selling "Spy School: Are You Sharp Enough to Be a KGB Agent?", a book filled with know-how to improve the memory of intelligence agents whose brains are their weapons.

By fixing your attention on the center of the table, using only your peripheral vision, and repeating the training of finding numbers in order starting from 1, you can train the peripheral vision, attention, concentration, and self-control necessary for memory.

It was originally devised by German psychiatrist and psychotherapist Walter Schulte as a diagnostic test to study attentional characteristics.


◆◇ Improving your peripheral vision is a shortcut to improving your skills!

Improving peripheral vision, which is the ability to see a wide range, is essential for efficient skill improvement.

It is said that 80% of the information that we humans receive from the outside world is handled by our eyes.

Information obtained from the eyes is sent to the brain, where it is recognized (memory, learning, thinking, judgment) and executed (motor control, etc.).

It goes without saying that a lot of information is required for correct execution.
